name: cmux
summary: cmux sends anonymous analytics to PostHog and crash reports to Sentry, and fetches remote feature flags. The macOS app has this on by default (app.sendAnonymousTelemetry defaults to true). A merged PR makes telemetry opt-in only for the standalone daemons and Chief, not for the Mac app.

optOut.instructions: Turn off Settings > App > "Send anonymous telemetry" (or set app.sendAnonymousTelemetry to false in ~/.config/cmux/cmux.json), then restart cmux because the setting is read once at launch. Administrators can force it off with the DisableTelemetry key in a managed profile for com.cmuxterm.app.
